SELF_DECLARED.label: Self-declared
SELF_DECLARED.hint: Declared by the owner, not verified

VERIFIED_SANDBOX.label: Simulated
VERIFIED_SANDBOX.hint: Simulated verification, not a real one

FILE_HASH.label: File fingerprint (SHA-256)
FILE_HASH.desc: Upload the original to the vault; the system stores the file's SHA-256 fingerprint.
FILE_HASH.fileIntro: Upload the original document (PDF, DOC/DOCX, PNG or JPG, up to 10 MB). The system stores its SHA-256 fingerprint so a later change to the file can be detected. This does not prove the document is genuine.

SECOND_PERSON_CONFIRM.label: Second-person confirmation
SECOND_PERSON_CONFIRM.desc: A code is sent to your trusted (DMS) confirmers; whoever has seen the original reads it back to you to enter.

OTP_EMAIL.label: Email OTP code
OTP_EMAIL.desc: Receive a code at the asset's email and enter it.

GOOGLE_LOGIN.label: Google sign-in
GOOGLE_LOGIN.desc: Sign in with the Google account you declared.

SMS_CODE_MOCK.label: SMS code (simulated)
SMS_CODE_MOCK.desc: Enter the simulated SMS code sent to the declared phone.

PAYPAL_LOGIN.label: PayPal (simulated)
PAYPAL_LOGIN.desc: Confirm the PayPal account with a challenge code.

BANK_NAME_LOOKUP_MOCK.label: Bank account name lookup (simulated)
BANK_NAME_LOOKUP_MOCK.desc: Match the declared bank account holder name.
BANK_NAME_LOOKUP_MOCK.autoIntro: The system compares the declared account holder name with the vault owner's name. This is a simulation and no real bank is contacted.

BANK_FORMAT_CHECK.label: Account number format check
BANK_FORMAT_CHECK.desc: Verify that the bank account number matches valid format rules.
BANK_FORMAT_CHECK.autoIntro: The system checks the account number length for this bank. It only checks the format and does not prove you own the account.

STATEMENT_UPLOAD.label: Bank statement upload
STATEMENT_UPLOAD.desc: Upload a bank statement to the vault for verification.
STATEMENT_UPLOAD.fileIntro: Upload a bank statement (PDF, DOC/DOCX, PNG or JPG, up to 10 MB) to store in the vault's documents.

MICRO_DEPOSIT_MOCK.label: Micro-deposit code (simulated)
MICRO_DEPOSIT_MOCK.desc: Enter the simulated micro-deposit code sent to the bank account.

EXCHANGE_EMAIL_CODE.label: Exchange email code
EXCHANGE_EMAIL_CODE.desc: Enter the verification code sent to the exchange account email.

API_READONLY_MOCK.label: Read-only API key (simulated)
API_READONLY_MOCK.desc: Verify read-only connection to the exchange account.

ADDRESS_CHECKSUM.label: Wallet address check
ADDRESS_CHECKSUM.desc: Check the format and checksum of the wallet address.

BIP39_CHECK.label: Recovery phrase check
BIP39_CHECK.desc: Check that the stored recovery phrase is a valid BIP-39 phrase.

PUBLIC_BALANCE.label: Public balance lookup
PUBLIC_BALANCE.desc: Look up the public balance of the address on the blockchain.

WALLET_SIGNATURE.label: Wallet signature
WALLET_SIGNATURE.desc: Sign a message with the wallet to prove you hold the key.

BIO_CHALLENGE_MOCK.label: Bio challenge (simulated)
BIO_CHALLENGE_MOCK.desc: Put a challenge code in the account's bio.

SCREENSHOT_UPLOAD.label: Profile screenshot
SCREENSHOT_UPLOAD.desc: Upload a screenshot of the account profile page to the vault.
